# DOC_INDEX.md — where to look, and how much of it to read

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-doc-index.mjs. Run `npm run docs:index`. Do not edit by hand. -->

This repo's documentation is larger than any context window. Reading it whole is not thorough,
it is a truncation you will not be told about. **Budget ~25k tokens for orientation:** read
`CLAUDE.md` in full, read `src/types/database.ts` in full, then use the tables below to open
only the sections your task touches. Use `sed -n 'START,ENDp' FILE` — the line ranges are exact.

After a context compaction, do **not** re-read any of this.

## The rule this index exists to enforce

A document is not free to keep. Every line in `APP_MANIFEST.md` and `MEMORY.md` is read by
every session, forever, and paid for in context that is then not available for the code. When
an item closes, move it out. When a plan ships, archive it. When a claim is dated, it is an
incident write-up and belongs in `docs/incidents/`.
